🏈 Road to Glory: College Football
[Public Beta]

Use Code 'CAREERMODEV1' and 'YOURLEGACY' for Re-Rolls :)

⚠ This game is currently in development. Expect bugs, glitches, balance changes, and unfinished content. ⚠  
Report issues and feedback in the official community server.

Begin your journey from unknown prospect to college football legend.  
Create your player, earn offers, compete under the lights, and build your legacy in an immersive college football experience on Roblox.

🔥 Features
• Career / Road to Glory Progression  
• Realistic College Football Gameplay  
• Player Progression & Rankings  
• Competitive Multiplayer Matchups  
• Custom Animations, Stadiums & UI  
• Frequent Updates During Development

🎮 Best Experienced On:
PC • Console • Mobile  
Recommended: Fullscreen + High FPS

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite to support development!
